newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico closes Dos Bocas crude port in high winds.
newsitem.headline: Mexico closes Dos Bocas crude port in high winds.

text.p: Mexico's crude oil shipping port Dos Bocas remains closed Monday because of high winds, the state-owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) confirmed.

Dos Bocas was first closed Saturday. Port spokeswomen Evelyn Perez explained that waves of between 10 and 12 feet high forced authorities to take the preventative action for the terminal in Tabasco state.
The port is the only of Pemex's three large crude export ports closed due to bad weather.
Strong gusts closed four other large ports and four smaller ports over the weekend, all of which have now reopened, according to the communications and transportation ministry.
A storm front in the area could worsen later this week, the ministry said, and convert into a tropical storm as it moves southeast across the Yucatan peninsula, the ministry said.
